Rishikesh Tour Itinerary
Day 1: Delhi - Rishikesh
You'll be traveling in a Volvo around 6:00 p.m. from Majnu Ka Tila, Delhi.
Volvo will stop at a common point for dinner. (10 minutes)
- Meals are not included during the transit.
- Try not to stop for long and try reaching at the earliest so you have the whole day to enjoy Rishikesh.
- Due to rain, the traveling hours might increase.
- There's always a possibility of landslides in mountains, so keep that in mind and try to leave on time from Delhi, so you're not stuck in traffic for long.
Day 2: Rishikesh
Upon reaching Rishikesh, check-in at Rishikesh hostel. After settling down, get ready for the Rishikesh city tour. We will visit Lakshman Jhula, Ram Jhula, and other famous places of Rishikesh. Attend the famous Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat in the evening. Return back to the hostel.  A delicious vegetarian dinner is served in the hostel cafe around 9 PM.
Meals: Dinner
Day 3: Adventure Activities
Post breakfast around 9 AM, put on the shoes and get ready for the day packed with adventure activities. Head out towards the river rafting site where you will enjoy the thrilling rafting session. Along with that you will have Cliff Jumping and Body surfing experience. Head towards the beautiful campsite which will be your stay for the night. Evening snack will be served. Dinner will be served over the bonfire.
Meals: Breakfast, Snacks and Dinner
Day 4: Checkout
Wake up and have your breakfast. Later we will visit Neer Gaddu Waterfall. You are free to explore the waterfall on your own. Departure for Rishikesh followed by a drop to the bus stand, further proceed towards Delhi with beautiful memories.
Meals: Breakfast
Day 5: Reach Delhi
You'll reach Delhi by 8 a.m.
Although it depends on traffic and rain.
So do book your return flights/trains for the night.
Trip ends here.

Things to Do
River Rafting
River Rafting in Rishikesh is an unmissable water sport that will render you a lifetime experience in India. Under the perfect safety arrangements made at the place, there are customized packages for camping and trekking available in Rishikesh.
Rishikesh is one of the few sports in India that provides a destination for this thrilling water sport.
Bungee Jumping
For adventurous spirits, the pristine location at Mohan Choti has India's first fixed platform for bungee jumping. It is available in the Shivaliks, ahead of Rishikesh.
Cliff Jumping
Another exciting activity that you can indulge in during Rishikesh's stay is cliff jumping. Jump into the river from considerable height (high cliff) and let your wilderness cross the borders of thrill and adventure.
Flying fox
Flying fox as an adventure sport has made its presence felt in Rishikesh among the young and enthusiastic travelers. If you love adrenaline rush then go for this sport. Have a majestic view of the mighty Himalayas and let the wind roar beneath you while you glide over the majestic Ganga, on the cable.
Yoga festival
Be the part of the international yoga festival held here in the first week of March. Yoga enthusiastic from across the world participates to make it a world-class event.
Places to Visit
Lakshman Jhula
Lakshman Jhula across the river Ganga in Rishikesh is the famous hanging bridge that connects two villages, Tapovan and Jonk in Tehri Garhwal and Pauri Garhwal districts, respectively. Made up of iron, this 450-feet long bridge is situated at the height of 70 feet from the river. In the proximity of Lakshman Jhula, lie Terah Manzil temple, the Ram Jhula and the Lakshman temple.
Triveni Gha t
For those holy spirits, who want to meditate and absorb the serenity of Rishikesh, Triveni Ghat, situated on the bank of the holy river Ganga, makes the perfect destination. Watch out Maha Aarti of Ganga which happens every evening at this biggest Ghat in Rishikesh.
This Ghat has reference in Indian epics namely Mahabharata and Ramayana. It was the cremation ground for Lord Krishna.
To satisfy your camping craziness world-class camping experience can be availed in Rishikesh. Numerous tour operators ensure all the arrangements are made perfectly as per your safety and basic requirements.
Those who are on wellness vacations, there are a lot of wellness and spa retreats located in Rishikesh that claims to rejuvenate and relax you from mind and soul. Enjoy the extensive treatment and massage therapies rendered at various traditional spas.  Ayurveda, yoga and many other stress-relieving activities are clubbed together for relaxation.
Spend your vacations the way you like in this holy abode of the Ganges. A variety of options and packages facilities eases your tasks of laying hands on the best options in Rishikesh.
